description: This file contains the declaration of the CumsumSPMDExpander class, which is part of the TensorFlow DTensor MLIR expansion framework. It defines methods for expanding operations and computing layouts related to the 'cumsum' operation within the SPMD (Single Program Multiple Data) paradigm.
